overclaims: Over seven months, which included the April and September oil price peaks, US turbine fuel did not get much more expensive.
No deadline was stated; I judged the forecast on the seven months after the post, during the conflict.
EIA explains why US prices stayed low: high storage and record production.
checks.note: The evidence establishes lower Henry Hub prices, not actual turbine fuel costs. It does not establish April and September oil price peaks or conflict continuing throughout the assessment period. E3 discusses forecast price pressures; it does not establish historical causation or record production. The agreed outcome and citation excerpts and metadata match.
